outputs.explanation: Panel a shows a schematic icon of image cropping plus example micrographs; it is not a plot of averaged data, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel b shows micrograph images illustrating image spacing/separation, not a data plot.
Panel c shows micrographs with an inset/zoom, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel d shows grayscale micrographs with a brightness/contrast schematic slider, not a data plot.
Panel e shows micrograph/staining images with channel annotation icons, not a data plot.
Panel f shows grayscale channel micrographs and a schematic color-overlap diagram, not a data plot.
Panel g shows micrographs with calibration/intensity scale bars, not a plot of averaged data requiring individual points.
